newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Saab Automobile Feb U.S. sales up.
newsitem.headline: Saab Automobile Feb U.S. sales up.

text.p: Car maker Saab Automobile said on Tuesday its U.S. car sales rose 43 percent in February to 2,250 cars, compared to the same month a year earlier.
In February last year, the company sold 1,574 cars in the U.S, company spokesman Olle Wallen told Reuters.
So far this year, Saab Auto's U.S. car sales have risen 15 percent to 3,611 cars compared to 3,132 vehicles in the corresponding period in 1996.
"The main part (of sales) is made up of the Saab 900 with the five door model the most sold," Wallen said, adding that the 550 Cabriolet also has sold well.
Saab Auto is jointly owned by investment company Investor AB of Sweden and U.S. automotive group General Motors.
